Name: CS_LIGHTING_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Local light settings for each level of the Lighting Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Local Light Distance Factor
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the draw distance of local (point and spot) lights; smaller values make lights fade out closer to the camera. Retail: 0.5 Low, 0.75 Medium, 1 High, 1.2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Local Light Shadows Enabled
Fields.Description: Lets local lights cast shadows. Retail: off on Off and Low.

Fields.Name: Forward Pass Lighting Enabled
Fields.Description: Enables lighting in the forward rendering pass. Retail: off on Off and Low.

Fields.Name: Local Light Shadow Level Limit
Fields.Description: Highest local-light shadow level that may cast shadows; higher values let more lights cast shadows. Retail: 5 on every row.
